summary: All three requirements have been successfully implemented. The diff shows the addition of background music functionality to the homepage with proper volume control integration, autoplay handling, and page navigation lifecycle management.

hallucinated_features.description: Volume control state persistence across page navigation using Zustand persist middleware
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly lists 'Adding volume slider controls' as a non-goal, but the implementation includes volume state persistence (volume and userMuted fields) in localStorage via Zustand's persist middleware. While this enables volume icon state persistence (which is an AC for REQ-2), the volume value itself (0.15) is being persisted, which goes slightly beyond the requested toggle functionality.
